leadText: Volume 3: Electric Pikachu Boogaloo is the third of four volumes of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu created by 小野 敏洋 Toshihiro Ono.
plainText:
Volume 3: Electric Pikachu Boogaloo is the third of four volumes of the manga series The Electric Tale of Pikachu created by 小野 敏洋 Toshihiro Ono. 

==Publications==
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 

==Chapters==
Chapter 1: I'm Your Venusaur
Chapter 2: Clefairy in Space
Chapter 3: Days of Gloom and Glory
Chapter 4: Welcome to the Big Leagues
Chapter 5: The Indigo Finals
Chapter 6: The Orange Islands

==Important events==
 
competes in the Indigo Plateau Conference.
Ash embarks on his journey to the Orange Islands.

==Party changes==
===Additions===
The following Pokémon are obtained:
Ash's in ET14.

==Monthly releases==
 
Just like the first two volumes, Electric Pikachu Boogaloo was released by VIZ Media as four monthly issues containing one to two chapters each, comprising the entire volume collectively, which was released separately. These monthly comic book issues were released from July 23, through October 22, 1999. As a bonus, these monthly releases each contained fan letters and fan artwork which were not included in the regular volume releases. 

The following monthly comic book issues were released:
Issue 1
Issue 2
Issue 3
Issue 4
